verdict.rationale: Helicone's docs show session grouping to trace multi-request flows (helicone-docs-5/6), per-user cache namespaces (helicone-docs-13), and property-based webhook filtering (helicone-docs-10), implying support for custom metadata tagging, but the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of a dedicated cost-by-user/feature dashboard or metadata tagging API for cost attribution.
